meta.name: game-qa
meta.description: Verify a game with evidence on its selected target runtime. Launch the actual build and check logs, real rendering, input and state changes, the core loop, designed outcomes, restart, target display modes, interface language, first-time onboarding, and whether the core fantasy is actually performed — without dressing subjective fun up as a certain verdict. Use for test a generated game, QA a game build, check whether the game is fully playable, verify the build. 游戏证据化质量验证。在选定的目标运行环境中启动实际构建，检查日志、真实画面、输入与状态变化、核心循环、设计要求的结果、重开、目标显示模式、界面语言、首次上手与核心幻想是否真正出现，不把主观趣味包装成确定性结论。用于测试生成游戏、检查游戏能否完整游玩等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 启动游戏构建并核对运行证据，判定游戏是否可玩
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你拿到游戏构建，想用证据确认它能完整游玩
copy.tagline_en: Launch the game build and verify playability through real runtime evidence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a game build and need to confirm it's fully playable with evidence

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按证据化流程实际启动游戏构建，检查日志、真实画面、输入与状态、核心循环、重开、显示模式、界面语言、首次上手等，产出 QA_REPORT.md 与 release-gates.json。
howto.when: 当你要求测试生成的游戏、QA 游戏构建，或检查游戏能否完整可玩时触发。

say.text: 请对这个游戏构建做一次完整 QA，输出报告。
say.note: 会启动实际构建并检查证据，生成 QA_REPORT.md。

say.text: 验证一下这个游戏能否在目标环境完整跑通核心流程。
say.note: 会检查日志、渲染、输入、重开等。

say.text: 这个构建的首次上手，帮我看看玩家能不能看懂。
say.note: 会走首次上手检查，记录理解度。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will launch the actual game build and verify logs, real rendering, input/state changes, core loop, restart, display modes, interface language, first-time onboarding, etc., producing QA_REPORT.md and release-gates.json.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to test a generated game, QA a game build, or check whether the game is fully playable.

say_en.text: Run a full QA on this game build and output the report.
say_en.note: It launches the build, checks evidence, and creates QA_REPORT.md.

say_en.text: Verify whether this game can complete its core loop on the target environment.
say_en.note: Checks logs, rendering, input, restart, etc.

say_en.text: Check whether the first-time onboarding is understandable in this build.
say_en.note: Runs the premise gate and records comprehension.
